title: A Common Structure Behind Birth Stopping Rules
summary: We study stopping rules in which each family is assigned a positive integer and stops the first time its number of girls equals that integer plus a fixed nonnegative integer multiple of its number of boys. After all families have stopped, we ask for the expected proportion of boys and the expected boy-to-girl ratio in the combined population, and show that both expectations depend on the assigned integers only through their sum.
